preconditions: Adjustments are the dilution ledger (write-offs, credit notes, post-issue discounts) — remaining_cents subtracts them, except a credit note with credit_outcome 'refunded_outside', which records a refund made outside Simpler and moves no money. To record one: invoice_adjustment_record (approval-gated).

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor — pass a previous response's next_cursor verbatim. null next_cursor means no further pages.

limit.description: Page size 1-200. Omit BOTH limit and cursor for the legacy bare-array first page of 200; pass either to get { items, next_cursor, limit } instead.
